Metrics are described as bullshit metrics

SOLUTION

Mixpanel has built analytics software
for product and marketing. As we
continue to penetrate organizations,
we will build software for sales and
finance next.

TopPitchDeck

key_points: Mixpanel has built analytics software for product and marketing
The company plans to continue penetrating organizations
Future software development will target sales and finance next
